rule: receiver reconcile counts every invoice it covers exactly once (resolved + open + unknown = targets), each in its own bucket (resolved: final when listed, or settled, canceled or not-created as LND or the record decided it; open: OPEN or ACCEPTED in LND as the pass looked it up; unknown: only when the pass was stopped, a lookup of it got no answer, a cancel of it by the pass failed, or a creating invoice was not found within its creation window), and exits 75 iff unknown > 0, else 0.
message: reconcile counted 0 (resolved 0, open 0, unknown 0) for 1 target invoice(s)
